obligation: readout descent after the candidate attachment transport; no physical identification assumed
question: Can the full-comparison-as-reference refinement be identified with one static finite JSON content per existing named fibre?
hypothesesUnderTest: Each of the 80 named fibre identities has one finite JSON value
Its paired P and E presentations expose that same value
A reference record reads the value of the fibre associated with its reference cell
An upstream comparison result at a presentation cell is literally the static value of that cell's associated fibre
method: Build the whole producer-to-referenced-fibre dependency graph from retained contact profiles and the existing presentation binding. Locate cycles, especially a producer that strictly contains its own assigned fibre value as a record payload.
rank: Number of nodes in the finite JSON value tree. Every proper payload subtree has strictly smaller rank than its containing comparison object.
controls: Keep source and target presentation identities separate to test whether the obstruction is caused by their proposed identification
Show that rejecting static identification does not invalidate the prior local attachment
Reject erasing or wrapping histories as a silent repair
scope: An occurs-check on this precise static literal-content identification. It does not refute the carrier, the routing witness, an actual content fibration, dynamic history-bearing states, or graph-backed/coinductive representations. No alternative representation is installed.
